name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: An animated spinner for React and shadcn, that pauses off-screen and announces itself to screen readers.

meta.details: A quarter arc turning on a faint ring, the eased.dev status-badge mark. Spins on the compositor, pauses off-screen, freezes under reduced motion, announces itself unless visible text already does.

docs: Import Spinner from components/eased/spinner/spinner. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
